messages:
Priya (CS Lead): heads-up: multiple onboarding tenants hit ingestion timeouts this morning. need a short customer status + credits plan.
Noah (Success Ops): can eng/sre provide root cause + ETA? i'll draft the outbound.
Diego (Eng): root cause: ingestion coordinator raced under burst parallel commits, causing connection churn. patch deployed at 2024-10-03T09:12Z to introduce throttling.
Ruth (SRE): window of impact ~08:50-09:30 UTC. error rate peaked ~6%. we scaled worker pool and suppressed aggressive retries; metrics look stable.
Noah (Success Ops): draft outbound: "Hi — we experienced intermittent ingestion timeouts affecting some onboarding jobs this morning. Status: patch deployed and canary monitoring underway. Next: full rollout within 24–48h if stable. Compensation: a one-time onboarding credit applied automatically to affected tenants. Office hours 10/04 15:00 UTC; recording posted after. Support link: https://support.redwood.ai/onboard-ops"
Priya (CS Lead): tiny edits ok. product approved one-time credit per tenant?
Noah (Success Ops): product signed off; ops to apply credits within 48h after outreach.
Diego (Eng): adding to RCA: add synthetic test for parallel commit bursts and an alert for commit-rate to worker-capacity ratio.
Ruth (SRE): ill add a dashboard panel for affected tenants and a new alert.
Priya (CS Lead): who hosts office hours?
Noah (Success Ops): ill host CS; Diego + Ruth join for tech Q&A. OpsBot will create event.
OpsBot: Event created: "Onboarding Ingest Q&A" — 2024-10-04T15:00:00Z. Incident: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2024-1102. Recording will be attached.
Priya (CS Lead): thanks — ill personalize outreach for high-touch accounts and send after legal check. closing thread; reopen with RCA and recording.
